title: Kononenkogroup clients
description: Clients on black: a huge centred serif heading inside an oval ring of white circles with client names. The circles are full size and bright at the bottom of the oval and shrink and fade towards the top, as if the ring tilts towards you; as the section scrolls through, the ring fades in and turns into place. Phones show the heading alone.
notes: always dark: its root carries the dark class, so it reads the theme's dark tokens even on a light page
client names are plain text in circles (no logos); 16–20 names fill the ring
the ring uses CSS cos()/sin() and a registered @property; where those are missing, and below 1024px, only the heading shows
